name: claude-terminals
description: Launch preset grids of Claude Code terminals in the editor area.

commands.title: Claude Grid: Grid All Editor Tabs

claudeTerminals.defaultCommand.description: Command sent to each terminal when a preset doesn't specify its own command.

claudeTerminals.launchStaggerMs.description: Delay (ms) between starting each terminal's command. Staggering avoids multiple `claude` sessions racing to refresh auth at once, which can force a re-login. Set to 0 to launch them simultaneously.

claudeTerminals.maxColumns.description: Maximum terminals per row in the grid. The grid uses the fewest rows that keep each row at or under this, then balances evenly (10 with a cap of 5 → 5/5; with a cap of 3 → 3/3/2/2). Lower this on small laptop screens (e.g. 2) so Claude's UI stays readable; raise it (e.g. 5) on a large external monitor.

claudeTerminals.spilloverThreshold.description: Maximum terminals to open in the current window. If a preset asks for more, the extra terminals open in a new VS Code window (each window tiled on its own) — handy for keeping a small screen uncluttered or spreading agents across monitors. For example, 10 with a threshold of 6 opens 6 here and 4 in a new window. Set to 0 to always keep every terminal in one window.

claudeTerminals.autoRegridOnClose.description: When you close one of the Claude terminals, automatically re-tile the remaining ones into a fresh grid so the layout closes the gap (e.g. a 2×2 grid with one closed collapses to a row of 3). Turn off to leave the layout untouched after a close.

claudeTerminals.notifyOnFinish.description: Show an OS-native notification banner when a Claude terminal finishes a turn (detected via the terminal bell Claude rings when it's done and waiting on you). Requires the `terminalDataWriteEvent` proposed API to be enabled — see the README. Also requires Claude Code's terminal-bell notifications to be on.

claudeTerminals.notifyOnlyWhenUnfocused.description: Only send finish notifications when the VS Code window is not focused, so you aren't pinged while actively watching the grid. Off by default (notify regardless of focus).

claudeTerminals.notifyCooldownMs.description: Minimum time (ms) between finish notifications from the same terminal, so a burst of bells or a TUI repaint collapses into a single banner.

claudeTerminals.presets.description: Presets shown in the picker and sidebar. Each preset is either { name, count } (opens N terminals running the default command) or { name, terminals: [{ name?, cwd?, command? }] } for full control.
